scripts.text: This boy must be the one who Ktullanux tried to protect.
- The boy was frozen inside a giant ice pole, and he looks as if he is in sleep rather than dead. -

- You felt freezing as you come closer to the giant ice pole that held the boy within,
- but for some reason, you felt a mysterious power from the pole. -
- The boy appeared to be snowy white, and beautiful from the head to the toe. -

- You wondered why a young boy had to be confined within this isolated cave, -
- you instinctively knew that no mage in this world would be able to release him from the ice pole.
What happened to this boy?

^3131FFLoomin, the boy
trapped in the Ice Cave.^000000
Class: 1st
 
 
 
^333333The pope was born together
with a twin brother, a fair
skinned boy with pale skin
and silver blond hair. This
had never happened before
and presented a unique problem
 
High Priest Niren acted as
their maternity nurse and
came to Rachel, where the
twins were cared for by the
Priests. They all argued
over the boy's ultimate fate...
 
No one doubted that the boy
was spiritually powerful, but
was he a sacred complement to
his sister, or a great evil that
was in direct opposition to
her? It was a grueling debate
 
In the end, the High Priests
decided that the boy posed
a great risk to their society
People may not consider the
pope's birth as divine if they
knew she had a twin brother.
 
However, not wanting to fear
the wrath of the gods, the
High Priests did not kill the
boy. Instead, they sealed
him in the Ice Cave.
 
The High Priests made
a contract with Ktullanux,
a fearsome ice monster, to
guard the boy's prison, and
to insure that no one would.

scripts.speaker: Citizen
scripts.text:
May Freya bless
you, and give you an
abundance of health,
wealth, joy, and happiness!

scripts.speaker: Citizen
scripts.text:
Freya is the goddess of
love and beauty. Do you
think that if I pray hard
enough, she'll help me
get a really pretty girlfriend?

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
I've never seen our pope
before, I hear that she has
silver blond hair and really
white skin. Daddy says that
only one girl is like that
in every generation.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
My daddy says the pope is
very special to us because
she's Freya. I mean, Freya
is a goddess, but she also
becomes people like us to talk
to us. Well, just the priests...

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
I don't get it all,
but it sounds like
she's a secret princess.
Doesn't that sound so nice?
But when I tell that to Daddy,
he gets so mad at me! Oh, well.

scripts.speaker: Cheshrumnir Guard
scripts.text:
You are at Cheshrumnir,
the hallowed grounds occupied
by our pope, Freya's mortal
incarnation. In respect for
her Excellency, I expect you
to enter with a pious heart.

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text:
If you open this door, you
can go inside this house,
and live in one of the rooms!
Then, you can add your couches
and a bed, and all of your stuff!

scripts.speaker: Kid
scripts.text:
All you gotta do is...
Ugh! Turn this knob
and... Grrrrah! Open
this door... But it's
almost impossible..

scripts.speaker: Anku
scripts.text:
It's been so long
already! I can't find
Himuhimu! Hide-and-Seek
shouldn't take this long...

scripts.speaker: Anku
scripts.text:
Oh, I'm already hungry...
Himuhimu, come out so
we can go home and eat!
Himuhimu! I give up!
H-Himuhimu...?

scripts.speaker: Himuhimu
scripts.text:
Zzzz...Z...
Anku, you'll never
find m... never find
me here... Zzzzz...
... So hungry...

scripts.speaker: Rachel Guard
scripts.text:
Welcome to Rachel
the capital of Arunafeltz.
Please ask our guide
at the center of the city
for information and
guest services.

scripts.speaker: Rachel Priest
scripts.text:
Bwahahaha! Somehow,
drinks taste much better
during work hours!

scripts.speaker: Airship Guide
scripts.text:
The Schwarzwald Republic's
international Airship service
for Arunafeltz can only be
accessed in Rachel. Please
follow the mark on your
Mini-Map to find the Airport.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
All of Arunafeltz believes
in the goddess Freya, but
there are those of us that
are more seriously involved
in adoration and worship.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
First, there are ''Freya's
Followers,'' men and women
like me that dress in holy masks
and garments. I realize that our
dress may seem a bit peculiar
to you, but that is our way.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
Then, there are the Priests
who dress in clean, white
flowing robes. They work in
the temple and serve the
community as religious leaders.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
Among these priests are
the elite High Priests that
directly assist our pope.
They wear more colorful
clothes as a sign of their
higher status in Rachel.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
All of us work tirelessly
to bring prosperity to
Arunafeltz, and to carry
out the teachings of our
beloved goddess Freya.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
This...
bores me...

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
You!
Entertain me!
What? You can't tell me what to do!
You got it.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
Oh. That much is
true, I suppose.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
Well, then,
what will you be
doing to entertain me?
Here's a funny story...
I will do what you want me to do.

^3355FFYou told her the first
funny story that you
could think of.^000000

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
That's supposed to
be funny? I suppose
that I don't understand
hoi polloi humor.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Priest
scripts.text:
Fine, fine~
Let me see what these
item of yours can do...
Oh? Oh! That's wonderful!

scripts.speaker: Bard
scripts.text:
I've wandered this
land, singing my songs~
Searching for someone
for my heart longs~

scripts.speaker: Bard
scripts.text:
Can I fulfill this hope~?
Meeting the girl with
skin as white as lilies,
eyes sparkling like stars~
Yes, I'm talking about the pope~
Pope, yeah~ Pope, yeah~

You must be off your
rocker singing that
kind of song here
in Arunafeltz!

scripts.speaker: Follower Akarna
scripts.text:
Cheshrumnir...
It is said that one
day, our goddess Freya
will descend to this place
in all of her glory. I hope
that I live to see that.

^3355FFShe is completely
immersed in deep,
meditative prayer.
It'd be rude to
disturb her now.^000000

scripts.speaker: Follower Lekua
scripts.text:
Look at these flowers.
Aren't they so beautiful?
I've spent a lot of time
cultivating this flower garden.

scripts.speaker: Follower Lekua
scripts.text:
I think it's Freya's
will for us to
bring as much beauty into
the world as we can. What
do you think about that?

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
Once again, I didn't get
any sleep yesterday... I'm
praying so hard for Freya's
second coming. I'm exhausted,
but I feel pretty good about
making that small sacrifice.

scripts.speaker: Freya's Follower
scripts.text:
You have done well,
my brother. I am certain
that Freya would be proud
of all your effots.

scripts.speaker: Child Follower
scripts.text: No! My Mingming is dead!
Mingming?

scripts.speaker: Child Follower
scripts.text:
Mingming is a sick bird
I found on the street, and
I really wanted it to just
rest and be healthy again
but it died! Waaaaah!

scripts.speaker: Child Follower
scripts.text:
I... I'm going to
try to ask the pope!
M-maybe she can bring
Mingming back to life!
Do you know how I can
find our pope?

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Welcome to Arunafeltz,
adventurer! Enjoy your stay~
Are you a guide?
Thanks, have a good day.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Oh, actually, if you
want to speak to a guide,
head west to Rachel, and
then go north from the plaza
in the center of the city.
You'll find one over there.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
My name is Papaii,
and I've been sent here to
promote the upcoming festival
in honor of Freya. I encourage
you to donate for our festival
if you can spare the zeny.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
If you're interested in
learning more, then please
visit our temple, which will
be accepting donations and
hosting the festival, and
speak to Priestess Nemma.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
If you donate, you can
receive Lottery Tickets
that you can redeem for
randomly selected items from
the temple's storage. May
Freya bless you, traveler~

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
May Freya bless you.
If you have time, please
visit our temple and make
a donation if you can~

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Welcome to Arunafeltz!
The city over the rampart
is Rachel, the capital of
Arunafeltz. If you'd like to
rest from your travels, why
don't you visit Rachel?
Are you a guide?
Tell me more about Rachel.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Actually, my name is
Papaii, and I'm stationed
here on behalf of the temple
spread awareness of this our
religion to visiting tourists.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
The entire nation of
Arunafeltz worships the
goddess Freya, and most
aspects of our lives are
largely influenced by our
religion. Did you know that?

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
I invite you to visit
our temple if you'd like
to learn more about goddess
Freya. May Freya guide you
in all that you do, and may she
protect you in your journeys!

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Welcome to Arunafeltz!
The city over the rampart
is Rachel, the capital of
Arunafeltz. If you'd like to
rest from your travels, why
don't you visit Rachel?

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Well, Rachel used to be
a barren desert until our
goddess led our ancestors to
this land. They cultivated the
desert by Freya's grace, and
made this area habitable.

scripts.speaker: Papaii
scripts.text:
Everything that you see here
has been artificially created
by humans. See? The blessings
of Freya truly enable us to
do miraculous things. You'll
see once you enter the capital.

scripts.speaker: Deno
scripts.text:
Although we pray to
the goddess Freya and
ask her for all sorts of
things, we can't expect
her to do everything for us.

scripts.speaker: Deno
scripts.text:
As humans, it is our
responsibility to do all
in our power to conceive
our own happiness. We
believe that if it is Freya's
will, then it shall be realized.

scripts.speaker: Deno
scripts.text:
I know it might seem
a little confusing to
an outsider, the idea of
being reliant on our goddess
while relying our ourselves.

scripts.speaker: Lewei
scripts.text:
Shushh!
Be quiet.

scripts.speaker: Lewei
scripts.text:
Go away! If someone!
sees you, I'm gonna
get caught, you jerk!
What are you doing?
Alright.

scripts.speaker: Lewei
scripts.text:
Hellooo~?
Can't you see?
It's called Hide-and-
Go-Seek. Gee whiz!
Hurry, get away!

scripts.speaker: Lewei
scripts.text:
Hurry, and get
outta here!

scripts.speaker: Zhikka
scripts.text:
Shh! I'm playing
Hide-and-Seek. Would
you leave me alone, please?
I don't wanna get caught again!
Maybe it's because I always
use the same hiding place...

scripts.speaker: Emmet
scripts.text:
Oh my Freya! You scared me!
I thought you were one of the
kids playing Hide-and-Seek!
Ack! Get away, get away!
Can't let them find me!

scripts.speaker: Harse
scripts.text:
Where are yoooou~
Come out, come out
wherever you are~

scripts.speaker: Harse
scripts.text:
What the Freya?
What's a grown-up
doing around here?
Can't you see I'm
playing Hide-and-Go-Seek?

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
You know that the temple
in Rachel is accepting
donations? They're asking
for a lot of zeny, but my buddies
and I donated anyway. Heck, we
wanted to see what we could win~

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
One of my buddies was
real freakin' lucky. He
got some kind of album,
opened it up and found
some kinda card inside.
Really pretty stuff.

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
Another buddy of mine?
Not so lucky. He got a
Condensed White Potion...
Yeah, I don't blame him for
feeling a little gypped, but he
donated for a good cause, right?

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
Me? I got some yellow
bell shaped fruit. I didn't
really feel like eating it,
but after I took a bite,
it was like... whoa.
So refreshing!

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
Anyway, all the donations
will be used to fund some
kinda festival. Sooo, I don't
think they'll be holding this
special lottery anymore once
they get enough money, you know?

scripts.speaker: Adventurer
scripts.text:
You know, one of the
priestesses at the temple
in Rachel looked troubled
for some reason. I should've
asked what was bothering her,
and offered my help. Mm, nah.
